findings.reasoning: Static inspection reveals no dnd-kit drag handle, attributes, or listeners mounted in the provided code snippet. Furthermore, handleCardClick defensively filters clicks originating from interactive elements via target.closest('button, [role="menuitem"], input, a, table'). Accessible drag handles are standardly implemented as button elements, which are already intercepted and ignored by this check. Raising an issue regarding an unmounted, hypothetical non-button drag handle violates the presumption of correctness.

Static inspection reveals that the alleged layout overflow does not exist. First, the dropdown menu is placed outside normal flex flow via absolute positioning (`absolute top-3.5 right-3.5 z-20`). Second, the category pill, private badge, and tags are placed in a dedicated row below the title with `flex-wrap` enabled and tags capped via `.slice(0, 3)`. Third, the action buttons reside in their own separate row at the bottom of the card content, rather than sharing a single congested header row. Thus, there is no horizontal layout overflow pushing action buttons off-screen on 375px viewports.
